hypothesised_pattern: The target is highest (0.82-0.85) when x5 is strongly negative, rises with |x4| of either sign, and is lowest when x5 is positive and |x4| is moderate or small, with x1 adding a positive shift.
rationale: The three highest targets (0.84, 0.85, 0.82) all have x5 <= -1.65 with only moderate |x4| (0.56-0.77), while rows with x5 of about -1 and |x4| of 0.89-1.27 reach 0.66-0.69.
